notes.text: The sheet is handwritten throughout. It carries the section number 1.3 and formula labels (17), (22), (23), (24), (25). No date or independent title is visible. Pencil 37 at the lower-left edge is retained only as an archive-sheet comment; no author page number is supplied.

The opening source sentence contains 'non panachées' and 'on reste en plan'. It then writes the four-element expression C=Pi_1 amalg Pi_2=omega_1 amalg omega_2. The short cap-and-downstem superscripts in the first and third members of the displayed list are preserved with the recurring plus alternative at their first occurrence.

The author introduces 'la relation d'ordre dessus' and gives the two strict comparisons in (22). The diagram has four marked points and two upward diagonal arrows. Its lower-left to upper-right shaft passes continuously over a gap in the other shaft. The lower-left point has an additional cancelled label underneath.

Section 1.3 starts with a cancelled family phrase and then writes the indexed family and Sigma notation in (23). The text below revises famille to an interlinear ens. with the parenthesis 'écrit/écrite indiciellement'. The chosen live une/un and de reproduce the observed cancellation boundaries. The index notation was a contextual cue for indiciellement, while the cropped c and paired l strokes supplied the reading.

The first slanted note says 'c'est un élément de' and gives an expression with three P-shaped capitals. Its visible closing curve after the third capital precedes the opening curve leading X; that placement is retained. The old internal crossing and capital styles remain explicitly uncertain.

The source writes the pairwise quantified condition in (24) with the short raised-t abbreviation and 'non panachées'. The following definition has an added underlined heading, one live On, and a cancelled alors. Its final singular/plural ending remains open. The parenthesis uses the underlined word strictement and the written final panachée.

The second slanted note writes Card A=n and introduces the wording 'décomposition n-aire non panachée de X'. Décomposition and n-aire have their own visible underlines. The two low n-like occurrences are carried with a first-occurrence n/nu uncertainty.

After Considérons, (25) gives C as the indexed disjoint sum of the omega_alpha. The added passage calls sigma an 'involution ss pt fixe' and states that it induces a transposition on each omega_alpha. One crossed word below transposition remains physically unreadable. The page ends with the final source word a on a separate short line.

H's explicit notes were read in full. Its point note acknowledges all four diagram points and the cancelled lower-left item; its marginal note identifies two oblique notes in the left margin; its closing note acknowledges that the entire involution passage is added and that the page ends on a. Those acknowledged states are not counted as missing merely because of H's macro boundaries. H's style maps editorial uncertainty to \uncertain and author emphasis through its own emphasis convention; macro syntax alone has not been treated as a finding.
